name: OpenGL Point Rendering for Isosurfaces
definition: Rendering isosurfaces using OpenGL point primitives (GL_POINTS) instead of triangles, where points are rendered as discs. This method is prone to being fill-rate limited because points overlap to cover the surface and cannot be backface culled.
summary: OpenGL Point Rendering for Isosurfaces renders surfaces as hardware-accelerated discs to bypass polygon mesh generation costs, distinguishing itself by avoiding backface culling and causing dilation artifacts at silhouettes.
